fb.caption:
Ancelotti sent off. Raphinha sent off. Brazil lose to Japan. 😳

Japan 3–2 Brazil in Singapore: Japan led 2–0, Vinícius Júnior scored twice (both set up by Bruno Guimarães), then Tatsuhiro Sakamoto won it in the 91st minute. Carlo Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were both sent off after the winner. Ancelotti on the referee: "I don't think he had the experience to handle this kind of game."

Ancelotti blames the ref. Do you? 👇

Photos via Wikimedia Commons: Ancelotti, Vinícius Júnior, Raphinha, Bruno Guimarães by Bryan Berlin (CC BY-SA 4.0); Takefusa Kubo by Ali Mohammed Mahdi (CC BY-SA 4.0); Singapore National Stadium by Dietmar Rabich (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Argentina's No. 10 is empty. Who fits? 🇦🇷

In their first game without Lionel Messi, Argentina lost 2–1 to Uruguay at La Bombonera (Julián Álvarez scored). Nobody wore the 10: Lionel Scaloni says he hasn't picked a successor yet.

1 Álvarez · 2 Mac Allister · 3 Enzo Fernández — who should wear it? 👇
